decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presentation through 2019 and close fit with the firm's modular screening know-how suggest performance around aspiration, though the renamed niche positioning makes it the most vulnerable if results remain only modest.

The 2019 EU Stage V refresh across all models indicates the line received additional investment and likely met aspiration levels well enough to justify keeping a broad mobile shredder family in the portfolio.

Moving from a mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 signals rising organizational commitment, so with strong fit to the firm's mobile processing business management would likely continue it unless sales clearly disappointed.
The firm highlighted this stationary pre-shredder generation as setting standards in 2019, which implies results and strategic importance above aspiration and makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
